import math
def angle(a,b,c):
 p=conf.GetAtomPosition(a);q=conf.GetAtomPosition(b);r=conf.GetAtomPosition(c)
 v1=(p.x-q.x,p.y-q.y,p.z-q.z);v2=(r.x-q.x,r.y-q.y,r.z-q.z)
 dot=sum(x*y for x,y in zip(v1,v2)); n1=math.sqrt(sum(x*x for x in v1));n2=math.sqrt(sum(x*x for x in v2))
 return math.degrees(math.acos(max(-1,min(1,dot/n1/n2))))

import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
Os=np.array([0.,0.,0.]); P=np.array([-2.35,0.,0.]); N=np.array([0.,0.,-2.2])
def ang(a,b,c):
 v=a-b;w=c-b
 return np.degrees(np.arccos(np.dot(v,w)/np.linalg.norm(v)/np.linalg.norm(w)))
def res(x):
 c1=x[:3];c2=x[3:]
 return np.array([
  np.linalg.norm(P-c1)-1.87,
  np.linalg.norm(c1-c2)-1.54,
  np.linalg.norm(c2-N)-1.47,
  (ang(Os,P,c1)-105)/20,
  (ang(P,c1,c2)-109.5)/20,
  (ang(c1,c2,N)-109.5)/20,
  (ang(c2,N,Os)-109.5)/20,
  # encourage c1 more outward than c2 and positive y
 ])
for init in [
 [-2.3,1,-1.5,-1,1,-2.5],
 [-2.3,1,-1.5,-1,1,-2.8],
 [-2.3,-1,-1.5,-1,-1,-2.8],
 [-2.3,0,-2,-1,0,-3],
 [-2.3,1.5,-1.0,-1,1.5,-2.2],
]:
 r=least_squares(res,init,xtol=1e-13,gtol=1e-13,ftol=1e-13,max_nfev=10000)
 c1=r.x[:3];c2=r.x[3:]
 print('cost',r.cost,'c1',c1,'c2',c2)
 print('dists',np.linalg.norm(P-c1),np.linalg.norm(c1-c2),np.linalg.norm(c2-N),'angles',ang(Os,P,c1),ang(P,c1,c2),ang(c1,c2,N),ang(c2,N,Os))
